description: backend.rs defines BackendSetError<E> with a SetError variant, but there is no impl From<SetError> for BackendSetError<E>. Backend implementations that want to return a SetError must write BackendSetError::SetError(SetError::new(...)) at every call site. impl<E> From<SetError> for BackendSetError<E> { fn from(e: SetError) -> Self { Self::SetError(e) } } would allow ? to convert SetError into BackendSetError and make backend implementations shorter and more readable. This is the standard Rust pattern for error variant wrapping.
title: BackendSetError missing From<SetError> impl: callers construct BackendSetError::SetError(se) manually
